steps.caption: Open Leases, then the Renewals tab.
Upcoming renewals: leases that expire within 12 months and have no renewal record yet. Peregrine Loom Studios expires on 30 June 2027.
The renewal notice deadline is 30 December 2026 — six months before expiry, from clause 4.2 on page 3.
In the Renewal section press Start renewal review. A review task is created for you.
The review starts at stage upcoming. Record the stage, the tenant's and the landlord's responses and a note.
Update. Every change is logged with the date.
When your recorded supply has similar spaces, 'Possible alternatives' appears here too — useful if the client may relocate.
Back on Renewals, the lease now sits in the Discussion column. Other columns: proposals pending, negotiation, agreed, completed and at risk.
To compare staying with moving, open Deal toolkit → Stay or move: rent, overlap, moving costs and deposits, worked out by fixed formulas.
